independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG4 implementation, test, register row, ADR or repair in the reviewed candidate. That includes T-DG4-ARCH-R6, T-DG4-KBE-R7, T-DG4-FE-R6, T-DG4-ARCH-R7, T-DG4-KBE-R8 and T-DG4-FE-R7. I formed this verdict from my own runs in a complete (non-shallow) disposable clone of afba46f (source ccc37c9) under $TMPDIR, on disposable PostgreSQL clusters. The clone was removed at the end. I re-ran my round-3 probes dom-api.mjs, dom-ui.mjs and dom-pct.mjs unchanged. dom-gross4.mjs is my round-3 dom-gross3.mjs with world B's expectation changed to D-123 item 1 and the RAG lines added. dom-kpiunit.mjs and zz-domain-r4.test.ts are new. The probes were placed only in the clone. I read the repair diff 925f0bc..ccc37c9, D-122 to D-126 and the ADR-0037 amendments N4 and N5 only to understand the change. I did not open any other reviewer's round-4 record or evidence.

Four KPIs (percentage with no label, '%', '% of users', and ratio 3/2) on an outcome created through the API, plus an archived outcome; read on T10 (Outcomes, People, Value gap), its drill-downs, the Overview and its drill-down, and the adoption dashboard, in EN and AR. checks_run.procedure: Confirm the operating-logic list of the assignment (calculations, benefits, Finance validation, SLAs, escalation, blockers, meetings, corrective actions, status separation, BAU, after closure, G5/G6, waivers, the Modular G3 waiver, change requests, dashboards, traceability) through the integration and acceptance suites, my API probes and the unchanged non-reporting modules. checks_run.expected: The rules match their sources; the observations and the partial disclosures in the register are acceptable.
checks_run.actual: The A01–A14 acceptance and backend suites pass 1985/1985, and no workflow module outside reporting/ and kpi/dashboard-facts.ts changed. My round-3 conclusions hold. RAG comes from the KPI trajectory, never completion: my R4-7 KPIs with actuals but no trajectory stay Unknown, never green. Forecast, submitted, upside and scenario values never count as validated. Finance validation is FIN-only, with the correction chain kept. A non-financial benefit is n/a. Allocations over 100 % are refused, and over 110 % on links. Escalation happens once, to the next authority, in working days. Closure is refused while value is pending unless a transition decision exists. BAU acceptance is by the receiver only, and the recurring reviews are created once. G5 requires risk closure and the scale scope; G6 requires ownership transfer. Waivers carry an expiry and a compensating action. The Modular waiver covers missing links only and is refused when revoked or expired. A change request keeps its originals. QA-C O-2 (a record stays draft until activation while G1–G6 progress): acceptable, because the playbook defines phases and gates, not a record lifecycle. QA-B (409 on a Draft gate): DG2-approved contract behaviour; REQ-S04-010 requires only rejection. The register's partial disclosures (PB-065, PB-066, PB-075, S04-010, S04-014, S07-005, S07-007, S07-015, S08-006, S08-015, S13-003, S15-008, S20-011) are unchanged, honest and acceptable. The six dashboards are listed on the hub (unit test 'lists the six dashboards'). Each dashboard filters on organization, transformation, owner, period, phase and status, and every drill-down reaches its contributing records (R4-1, R4-7, R4-8).

summary: PASS. All three of my round-3 findings are CLOSED_VERIFIED on candidate 5ff36f6e. F-DG4-125: percentage KPIs read '12 %' or '12 % of users' and a ratio KPI '1.5' on every dashboard surface and drill-down in EN and AR, on the real stack with the real worker; the gap still reads '100 %'. F-DG4-126: the Value RAG is the worst of the per-basis gaps, Red in my R3-6 worlds on T10, the workstream dashboard, the Overview and Finance; the USD, missing-amount and control variants behave. F-DG4-127: the Portfolio value is 90 on the profit-and-cash basis, labelled; a top-line-only initiative is n/a and ranks last; a missing amount is Unknown. I accept D-123 items 1 and 4, D-124 item 1 and the N5 label rule against the sources. Full integration passes 1985/1985. One Node 24 unit flake in a DG2 session test is disclosed and passed 34/34 twice when re-run alone. I raise no new finding; the cosmetic residuals are recorded as observations.
